stories.headline: ‘He was devastatingly sexy’: Frasier’s Jane Leeves and David Hyde Pierce on the love between Daphne and Niles
stories.summary: “Dr Crane, your glockenspiel has sprung to life!” The psychiatrist Niles Crane (snooty, conflict-avoidant, married to a high-society wife with a fear of buffets) fell for his father’s physio, Daphne Moon (working class, Mancunian, reckons she’s a bit psychic) the moment he met her in his brother’s Seattle apartment. stories.headline: ‘Take out’ Los Angeles and San Diego? Trump is beyond irresponsible | Ted Widmer
stories.summary: Donald Trump was in Nebraska on Monday, and though his long rally speech had elements of a performance, this was no Bruce Springsteen album. The president drew fury when he suggested that Iran could launch a nuclear attack and “take out” Los Angeles or San Diego. Let them take, let it, let them take out Los Angeles.

stories.headline: Datacentre company Firmus’s high flying valuation may be coming back down to earth ahead of expected ASX debut
stories.summary: The momentum behind Firmus Technologies’ high-flying valuation is showing severe cracks just weeks out from its anticipated ASX debut. Multiple sources briefed on the matter told Guardian Australia the AI datacentre company is slashing its valuation to entice sceptical investors – or may even shelve its initial public offering altogether. - Jonathan Barrett is Guardian Australia’s business editor.

stories.headline: The AI industry is booming. Women are getting left behind
stories.summary: There’s a common fear among people who work in Silicon Valley: snag one of the fast-growing, high-paying jobs in artificial intelligence, or get trapped in the “permanent underclass”, a phrase describing the fate of those who won’t have upward mobility in the age of AI. But for women in tech, it’s starting to look like the present.

stories.headline: OpenAI’s release of mathematical findings draws concerns from experts
stories.summary: OpenAI has astounded mathematicians after releasing hundreds of new mathematical findings on Tuesday. The company published over 370 mathematical results across a variety of topics such as algebra, theoretical computer science and mathematical logic, showcasing what some of its most advanced artificial intelligence models are capable of. “We believe that human understanding of mathematics remains of paramount importance.
